ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_margin_weighted_logsigmoid_regularized_v2_repair
ir.intuition: Fix forward failure by replacing unsupported ops.pow with elementwise squared via multiplication; preserve key margin and regularization terms for stability and novelty.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_margin = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(scaled_margin)
regularizer = eps * (scaled_margin * scaled_margin)
weighted_loss = weight * (loss_per_pair + regularizer)
norm = sum(weight) + eps
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / norm
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.2)))
    beta = 0.1
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    regularizer = ops.mul(eps, ops.mul(scaled_margin, scaled_margin))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.add(loss_per_pair, regularizer))
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
